items.title: FAA Marks Major Milestone with Hybrid-Electric Flight Test in Utah
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration today announced that Ampaire Inc. and the Utah Department of Transportation conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight along Utah’s I-15 corridor to test future cargo service.
